package poll

type FD struct { fdmu fdMutex; isFile bool }
func errClosing(bool) error { return nil }
func (fd *FD) destroy() error { return nil }

func (fd *FD) readLock() error {
	if !fd.fdmu.rwlock(readlock, waitLock) {
		return errClosing(fd.isFile)
	}
	return nil
}

func (fd *FD) readUnlock() {
	if fd.fdmu.rwunlock(readlock) {
		fd.destroy()
	}
}

func (fd *FD) writeLock() error {
	if !fd.fdmu.rwlock(writeLock, waitLock) {
		return errClosing(fd.isFile)
	}
	return nil
}

func (fd *FD) writeUnlock() {
	if fd.fdmu.rwunlock(writeLock) {
		fd.destroy()
	}
}

func (fd *FD) incref() error {
	if !fd.fdmu.incref() {
		return errClosing(fd.isFile)
	}
	return nil
}

func (fd *FD) decref() error {
	if fd.fdmu.decref() {
		return fd.destroy()
	}
	return nil
}
